rationale: Baseline customer-minutes/year = 4024.00 from section fault rates, interrupted customers, and base restoration durations. With deployed FCIs at n2 and n4, each section uses the best available reduction: s12 6 min, s23 28 min, s24 26 min, s45 34 min; all reduced durations remain above the 25-minute floor, giving 3216.80 customer-minutes/year. Customer interruptions remain 45.80 per year, so SAIFI is unchanged.
